profile.headline: Web Developer, Drupal at Insulet Corporation

positions.title: Website Content Specialist
positions.description: Coordinated website projects from planning through go-live. Cross-browser and cross-device website QA. Troubleshoot and report website defects. Collaborated with key stakeholders to ensure project success.

positions.title: Search Engine Marketing Specialist
positions.description: Managed paid search campaigns and website SEO. Planned and executed product promotion campaigns. Analyzed, interpreted, and presented data.

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description: Designed web graphics, print and web ads, flyers, and signage. Created catalog page layout, proofread and preflighted catalog. Photographed products in studio and in the field.

positions.title: Marketing Coordinator / Graphic Designer
positions.description: Promotional materials development and website management for the annual Chagrin Valley Hunter Jumper Classic horse show. Designed and produced marketing materials. Coordinated mailing lists and materials distribution. Maintained website and created website content.

company.name: Chagrin Valley Professional Horsemen's Association Horse Shows, Inc.

positions.title: Layout Editor / Managing Editor
positions.description: Managed editorial and writing staff. Coordinated content for each issue and wrote articles. Proofread and edited all content. Gathered all content, edited images, and designed layout.

positions.title: Public Relations Assistant
positions.description: Communicated with clients and coordinated with vendors. Researched and planned client projects and events. Prepared media announcements, press releases, mailings, and fact sheets.
